source.title: 2026 Fantasy Football Sleepers: 5 Underrated Running Backs to Target
source.author: John McKechnie
source.summary: Five primary values plus deep contingent backs

takeaways.label: value
takeaways.summary: A clear lead role, proven volume and receiving ability create upper-RB2 value while Kamara recovers.
takeaways.rationale: A clear lead role, proven volume and receiving ability create upper-RB2 value while Kamara recovers.
risks: The fourth-round price is value rather than a classic sleeper price.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Early volume and short-yardage work can create flex weeks even after Love returns.
takeaways.rationale: Early volume and short-yardage work can create flex weeks even after Love returns.
risks: The ceiling and scoring environment are modest.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Strong rushing efficiency and a better Minnesota offense create standalone and contingent upside.
takeaways.rationale: Strong rushing efficiency and a better Minnesota offense create standalone and contingent upside.
risks: Aaron Jones still leads the depth chart and Mason's sample is smaller.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Power, after-contact production and likely goal-line work are underpriced.
takeaways.rationale: Power, after-contact production and likely goal-line work are underpriced.
risks: Tuten and LeQuint Allen can control other valuable roles.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Target-earning efficiency and a checkdown-heavy offense create a path to 50 catches.
takeaways.rationale: Target-earning efficiency and a checkdown-heavy offense create a path to 50 catches.
risks: The thesis is much weaker outside full PPR.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Demonstrated spike-week upside makes him a worthwhile final-round contingency.
takeaways.rationale: Demonstrated spike-week upside makes him a worthwhile final-round contingency.
risks: He likely needs an injury ahead of him.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: His 4.37 speed offers a small chance of usable splash weeks.
takeaways.rationale: His 4.37 speed offers a small chance of usable splash weeks.
risks: He may have no offensive role.

takeaways.label: sleeper
takeaways.summary: Kansas City's likely No. 2 back carries contingent upside and possible standalone work.
takeaways.rationale: Kansas City's likely No. 2 back carries contingent upside and possible standalone work.
risks: Kenneth Walker controls the backfield while healthy.
